issue: Private screens could remain loading or appear unresponsive while the public store stayed available.
causes: Supabase token refresh shares one pending future across authenticated reads; an unbounded Auth HTTP request could block those reads and reuse the same stuck future.
Session synchronization could repeatedly replace a verified same-owner profile with loading, and initial restoration was awaited ahead of subsequent auth events.
A private navigation request above the public store silently returned while account validation was unavailable, hiding AuthGate's error/retry screen.
Creation entry, font requests and price/ownership reads had unbounded waits or retained failed pending work.
Eight authentication stream listeners/forwarders lacked an error handler and could propagate a refresh outage as an unhandled zone exception.

backendEvidence.window: Last 24 hours at diagnosis; aggregated paths/status only. No customer identity/token contents queried.

fixes.authTransport: Exact Supabase origin /auth/v1 http.Request JSON exchanges: total headers+body deadline 20s, per-request abort, late responses discarded; non-Auth/storage/rest/functions/stream/multipart lifetimes preserved.
fixes.restoration: Whole session synchronization 25s; current-session single-flight; initial latest-result completer; same-owner transient failures keep validated data; logout/account change/explicit rejection still mask private state.
fixes.navigation: Private menu reveals the underlying account gate and retry UI without granting private access, then resumes the pending destination only after validation; a different owner discards it.
fixes.home: Album read deadline 25s and adjacent same-owner token refresh events deduplicated.
fixes.designEntry: Account/draft reads 12s, strict font preparation 40s, price/ownership reads 12s; session identity and draft revision checked after async work.
fixes.fonts: Per-file 25s and registration 12s, identity-safe cleanup, partial success retained, all faces validated before registering; no fallback editing/printing.
fixes.dependency: http 1.6.0 promoted from the same locked transitive version to an exact direct dependency; no package version upgraded.
